dedupe_keys.name: flexplan jl transmission and distribution expansion tool

description: FlexPlan.jl is a Julia package for joint transmission and distribution network expansion planning. The project publishes code, documentation, example scripts and a tutorial. Users supply power-network data, time series for demand and renewable supply, and candidate AC, DC, storage and flexibility investments. It builds a mixed-integer linear planning problem for one or more years, hours and probabilistic scenarios, then returns expansion decisions and operating results through a compatible solver. Geographic coverage is whichever network a user encodes; the planning horizon and hourly detail are chosen in the inputs. The code is free under BSD-3-Clause, although a commercial solver may be chosen for large cases. A limitation is that its linearised network formulations and scenario probabilities are modelling assumptions that need checking for each grid. It supports resilient grid investment studies. The catalogue's model-pandapower is a separate network-analysis package for comparison, not a FlexPlan dependency. No optimisation was run.
